== Content ==

=== Introduction ===
Serious about founding a religion which will be on par with Christianity in my lifetime

=== Background ===
I was not raised religious. But what I liked about religion was its ability to connect everything. I loved how in the Chronicles of Narnia everything had its place in the world and wished I could live in a world like that.

I couldn't find a good religion though. Seemed like all the religions actually in the world had none of this magic to them. The only ones that really seemed to have anything analogous were indigenous religions I couldn't really join. 

The religion I most seriously contemplated joining was Mormonism but I couldn't see myself in it as a queer person, and that's not even covering the bigger issues with the Church.

So for a long time I had resigned myself to no religion. Unless I had some kind of revelation I'd never be able to be part of a religion.

=== John Vervaeke and my mystical path ===
During the pandemic I got into [[John Vervaeke]]'s philosophy and [[HealthyGamerGG]] videos. I had the mystical experience of [[Alolalia]]

It was then that I realized that religion has to be customer-centric and simple.

=== Omega - Being customer-centric ===
Focusing on the needs of people right now rather than giving abstract lists of what they must do

Immortality. I can say all I want about [[longtermism]] and genetic reincarnation and only a small group of fanatics will listen, offer immortality and everyone is into the future

Two books called Blue Ocean Strategy and Zero to One convinced me my approach needed to change

=== ALO - simplicity ===
[[alo]] is an extremely simple concept. In the Bardo I had to explain everything but letters slipped out of my hands, so there was only ALO

=== MrBeast and Ukraine ===
MrBeast Burger showed to me times are changing economically and being a YouTuber is a better way to starting businesses than I thought

=== Why Lifeism will overcome Catholicism ===
The Catholic Church gets billions of dollars in revenue but doesn't use any of it to boost the customer experience at all.

If I was running the Catholic church with that amount of revenue I'd be training new priests like crazy to keep up with demand, hiring psychologists to figure out how to optimize the user experience, and using a data driven approach to growth, but instead they do none of this

Lifeism by contrast will constantly reinvest in itself to develop better practices. Pretty soon it will be able to outcompete all other religions.

=== Segue ===
This doesn't mean I don't have beliefs. I have an extensive series on my beliefs. You can watch the video here to learn more about them. Businesspeople have ethical beliefs too

Into [[A Systems-Oriented Theory of Everything|Lifeism Documentary]] to introduce the audience to my philosophical beliefs underlying the business proposition
